title: Warmly Spiced American Knafeh Casserole
description: A twist on traditional Middle Eastern knafeh, this casserole combines the warm spices of America with the sweet cheese of knafeh.
instructions: Butter a 9x13-inch baking dish and set aside.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the shredded phyllo dough and cook, stirring frequently, until golden brown.
Transfer the cooked phyllo dough to the prepared baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together the warmly spiced american cheese, confectioners' sugar, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
Pour the cheese mixture over the cooked phyllo dough.
Top with the shredded knafeh cheese.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
